topics.headline: No consensus available for Sep US CPI or EZ HICP vs prior prints
topics.summary: August readings showed US CPI YoY steady at 3.4% while Eurozone HICP rose to 3.2% from 2.9%, with energy driving recent gains. No economist forecasts or base-effect details located for the September releases, leaving the question unanswered.

topics.headline: HY OAS Unlikely to Widen in Next 30 Days
topics.summary: Current ICE BofA US High Yield Index OAS stands near multi-year tights at 3.12% with solid corporate earnings, low defaults, strong fund inflows, and calm conditions across IG credit and equity volatility; historical precedent shows sharp 30-day widening is rare absent major macro shocks.

topics.headline: US Spot Bitcoin ETFs Likely to See Net Inflows Next 7 Days
topics.summary: Recent data shows consistent positive momentum with $245M inflows on Sep 25, cumulative $58.2B, and average daily inflows of $180M over the prior two weeks, supported by Bitcoin near $112K and analyst commentary on sustained institutional buying into early October.

topics.headline: VIX Futures and Term Structure Signal Rise Above 3-Month Avg in 30 Days
topics.summary: Current VIX spot of 14.87 sits well below its 3-month average of 16.05 and VIX3M of 17.93; October futures settled near 17.50 while the term structure remains in contango with later months at 18.38-18.75, pointing to expected volatility normalization higher than the recent trailing average.

topics.headline: No imminent hyperscaler AI power deal in next 30 days
topics.summary: Multiple precedents exist of hyperscalers signing large dedicated nuclear, geothermal, and other generation PPAs for AI/data centers amid surging demand, but no public pipeline or filings indicate an announcement is scheduled in the immediate 30-day window.
